```yaml
name: Update Meeting Minutes

on:
  schedule:
    # Runs every day at 00:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  update-meeting-minutes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y curl jq

      - name: Fetch latest meeting minutes from Discourse
        id: fetch_minutes
        env:
          DISCOURSE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.DISCOURSE_API_KEY }}
          DISCOURSE_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.DISCOURSE_USERNAME }}
        run: |
          # Discourse API endpoint for the community category
          # Assuming category ID for "community" is known or needs to be discovered.
          # For meshery, the community category ID is typically 6 or similar. 
          # We will fetch the latest topic in the community category.
          
          DISCOURSE_URL="https://discuss.layer5.io"
          CATEGORY_ID=6 # Common ID for community, adjust if necessary based on actual Discourse config
          
          # Fetch the latest topic in the community category
          TOPIC_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X GET \
            -H "Accept: application/json" \
            -H "Api-Key: $DISCOURSE_API_KEY" \
            -H "Api-Username: $DISCOURSE_USERNAME" \
            "$DISCOURSE_URL/categories/$CATEGORY_ID.json")
          
          # Extract the latest topic ID
          LATEST_TOPIC_ID=$(echo $TOPIC_RESPONSE | jq -r '.latest_topic_id')
          
          if [ -z "$LATEST_TOPIC_ID" ] || [ "$LATEST_TOPIC_ID" == "null" ]; then
            echo "No new topics found in community category."
            exit 0
          fi

          # Fetch the post content of the latest topic
          POST_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X GET \
            -H "Accept: application/json" \
            -H "Api-Key: $DISCOURSE_API_KEY" \
            -H "Api-Username: $DISCOURSE_USERNAME" \
            "$DISCOURSE_URL/t/$LATEST_TOPIC_ID.json")
          
          # Extract the raw post content
          POST_CONTENT=$(echo $POST_RESPONSE | jq -r '.post_stream.posts[0].raw')
          POST_TITLE=$(echo $POST_RESPONSE | jq -r '.title')
          
          # Save to a temporary file
          echo "$POST_CONTENT" > /tmp/meeting_minutes.md
          
          # Set output for later steps
          echo "title=$POST_TITLE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "content_file=/tmp/meeting_minutes.md" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create archive directory if not exists
        run: |
          mkdir -p .github/meetings/archive

      - name: Generate filename and save minutes
        id: save_minutes
        run: |
          # Generate filename based on current date
          DATE=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
          FILENAME="meeting-${DATE}.md"
          FILEPATH=".github/meetings/archive/${FILENAME}"
          
          # Check if file already exists to avoid duplicate commits
          if [ -f "$FILEPATH" ]; then
            echo "File $FILEPATH already exists. Skipping."
            echo "skipped=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            exit 0
          fi
          
          # Copy content to the archive directory
          cp ${{ steps.fetch_minutes.outputs.content_file }} "$FILEPATH"
          
          # Add a header with the title if available
          TITLE="${{ steps.fetch_minutes.outputs.title }}"
          if [ -n "$TITLE" ] && [ "$TITLE" != "null" ]; then
            sed -i "1i# $TITLE\n" "$FILEPATH"
          fi
          
          echo "filepath=$FILEPATH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "skipped=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.save_minutes.outputs.skipped == 'false'
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          
          git add .github/meetings/archive/
          
          # Check if there are changes to commit
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "No changes to commit."
            exit 0
          fi
          
          git commit -m "docs: add meeting minutes for $(date +%Y-%m-%d)"
          git push origin HEAD:main
```
